## Requirements: Session Activity Server projection and Web/App status presentation

### User outcome / dependencies (2026-11-17)
**Depends on #3800 (Session Activity owner)**; practical providers are #3801 (Claude adapter, reusing #3779) and #3802 (Shell). On the existing flat Session list, users should tell at a glance which current Sessions are working, idle, unavailable/unknown or waiting for user input. **Activity is a fourth independent state dimension**, never a reinterpretation of `session.status`, Agent connectivity or client Attachment.

### Current source baseline
- `crates/nession-agent/src/sync/session_watcher.rs`: 5-second tmux inventory updates including `foreground_command` and `instance_id`; cannot infer business working/idle from this field.
- `crates/nession-agent/src/connection/server_client.rs` and `outbox.rs`: bounded replace-by-Session outgoing level messages, reconnect full resync.
- `crates/nession-protocol/src/contracts/session/v1.rs`: canonical `AgentSessionUpdatePayload`, `SessionInfo`, `WebSessionInfo` contracts (no duplicate TS-authored wire schema).
- `crates/nession-server/src/registry/session.rs`: runtime Session registry; current foreground command is explicitly in-memory, not persisted.
- `web/src/product/session/hooks/useSessionData.ts`: generation/revision-aware authoritative push/list reconciliation; `web/src/product/session/patterns/SessionItem.tsx`: existing Session navigation row; `docs/design/information-architecture.md` and `docs/design/capability-emergence.md` own quiet Session chrome.

### Proposed transport / state projection
**Source of truth is one Agent-owned ActivityCoordinator snapshot** (#3800). Publish a dedicated, versioned, instance-fenced Activity observation (or a semantically equivalent dedicated protocol unit) from Agent to Server; do **not** mutate lifecycle `status` strings or use a second front-end activity detector.

Agent → Server sample payload:
```json
{
  "agent_id": "a",
  "session_name": "s",
  "instance_id": "incarnation-uuid",
  "activity": {
    "state": "working",
    "capability_id": "claude-code",
    "attention": null,
    "observed_at_ms": 1700000000000
  },
  "generation": 17
}
```
Illustrative only; canonical Rust Protocol Kernel defines actual wire fields, generation semantics and codegen.

Server maintains **ephemeral** activity projection, not a write-per-state DB log:
- A late Activity update for a previous Session incarnation, Agent connection generation, retired Pane owner or older monotonic source generation is ignored. Server only accepts mutations from the authoritative live Agent identity; no stale socket can resurrect state.
- Full Agent re-registration and `agent.session.report`/force refresh reconcile Session existence and Activity **atomically enough to prevent refresh from clearing a newer activity**. Missing Activity from a legacy Agent means unknown, not idle.
- Server forwards Activity in `server.session.list` and authoritative `server.sessions.changed` projection, using the same shared serializer and one coherent row identity. P2P/Relay/remote attach paths do not need browser participation to continue sensing.
- On Agent offline/reconnect, display connectivity independently; Activity is `unknown`/stale until reverified, retaining last observation only in details with explicit timestamp if useful. No offline Working badge claimed as currently verified.
- Do not treat the Activity change as new Session interaction recency or refresh `last_activity` on every poll. Debounce/replace identical levels and keep fan-out bounded; include push/reconciliation errors and instrumentation.
- Preserve current Session list `useSessionData` request-vs-push revision fencing; **no stale list reply may replace a newer push**. Recreating same-named Session clears old Activity and metadata selection appropriately.

### UX / design contract
- Reuse the existing `SessionItem` anatomy on Web sidebar and App Session navigator, with Nession-owned low-noise activity semantics (small status indicator/accessible label) rather than a permanent extra column, a Capability badge parade, independent Agent selector or Capsule spinner.
- `working` visible without animation dependence; `idle` quiet; `unknown` explicit when inspection is requested (not deceptively rendered as idle). `attention: input_required` is distinct from failure/offline and should be discoverable without duplicating Agent error chrome. Underlying capability may show native details on explicit Session deepening.
- Desktop keyboard/focus and App touch/compact widths: stable row geometry and menu targets, truncation, text alternative/ARIA, reduced-motion, and no blinking/triple animation on every 5-second update.
- Filtering/sorting by working status can be considered after the basic list proves useful; **not** required here. Activity indicator does not auto-open a Capability Peek or modify resting Terminal Capsule.

### Prototype
- Decision: **Required** (owner explicitly requested an interactive prototype on 2026-11-17).
- Uncertainty: one quiet, accessible Activity glyph slot vs extra text/chips; clarity when input is required and when Agent offline invalidates a prior working observation; geometry with existing row menu.
- Scenario: Web 1180/1024 + App 390/375; Working → Idle, Needs input, Unknown, Agent offline/recovery and stale-report rejection. Navigate Session ↔ Terminal and inspect Session details without mutating real work.
- Status: **Source published to shared `prototype` branch; design in review.** Static/fixture verification passed; real-browser walkthrough and published Pages manifest verification remain **Pending** (not claimed).
- Immutable HTML source: [`session-activity-3804/index.html` at `d92f2398b6de23ee1afc1e00dc74ec469984aa34`](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/d92f2398b6de23ee1afc1e00dc74ec469984aa34/session-activity-3804/index.html); [source directory and README](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/tree/d92f2398b6de23ee1afc1e00dc74ec469984aa34/session-activity-3804).
- Shared gallery: [prototype catalog source](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/d92f2398b6de23ee1afc1e00dc74ec469984aa34/index.html).
- Candidate HTTPS preview: https://bestnathan.github.io/nession/prototypes/session-activity-3804/index.html — **not verified as deployed**; do not use as published design evidence until `prototypes/manifest.json` and HTTPS readback match the pinned SHA.
- Review checks: source JS parses; 7 synthetic Activity transitions checked (Working → Idle → Working → Needs input → Agent offline → re-sync → stale rejection → Unknown); list recency unchanged; viewports and relative frame sources present. No Chromium screenshots or functional UI clickthrough claimed.
- Fidelity: static, synthetic fixtures; no live Agent, tmux, native Claude/Codex CLI, persisted Session history or real protocol execution.

### SC → scenario / approved proof route
- SC-01, SC-02 → **SCN-03** native/protocol: approved isolated `full-stack-local` CI Case on merged staging SHA, Server+Agent connection replacement, session report/reconnect and forced delayed event/refresh; inspect ordered source/wire/store projection and browser-independent operation; require `e2e/acceptance/cases/<issue>/<SC>/`.
- SC-03, SC-04 → **SCN-02** Chromium+Playwright `type: browser` Case on merged staging SHA, Web 1180px / 1024px and App 390px / 375px touch contexts, fake realistic protocol pushes/force refresh and aria/DOM/geometry/focus assertions; source-aligned cases in approved CI. No physical Safari/iOS claim.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 A connected Agent's verified Activity levels appear identically in Server `session.list` and pushed `sessions.changed`, while independent Session/Agent/attachment values are unchanged and a legacy Agent with no Activity yields unknown.
- [ ] SC-02 Agent disconnect/reconnect, delayed/out-of-order updates, duplicate levels, same-name incarnation replacement and racing force refresh never show stale working as verified current status or overwrite a newer observation; snapshot resync restores the actual level without requiring a browser attach.
- [ ] SC-03 Web and App Session lists show distinct working/idle/unknown/needs-input outcomes with accessible status text/semantics, preserve Session identity, title/metadata and one existing row-actions menu, and remain navigable with keyboard and touch at compact widths.
- [ ] SC-04 Activity changes do not rewrite `last_activity`/recency, move/replace a Session row because of stale responses, open Capability Peek automatically, add a permanent resting Capsule spinner or create unbounded UI updates/animations; offline Agent state remains independently visible.

## Product alignment
- [x] Session-first navigation stays flat; Agent is metadata, not a parent route
- [x] `PRINCIPLE.md`: show what matters now, quiet presence, extensions supply data and Nession owns the experience
- [x] Independent activity/lifecycle/connectivity/attachment; no implicit AI conversation for every Session
